🩺 UNIVERSAL HEALTH CARE MUST REMAIN UNIVERSAL

 by Dr. Tony Leachon

The Department of Health’s recent proposal to disqualify road traffic “violators” from zero balance billing is not just flawed—it is dangerous.

This policy assumes guilt at the hospital door. It violates due process, punishes the poor, and turns our hospitals into courtrooms. It undermines the very foundation of Universal Health Care (UHC), which was never meant to be conditional or punitive.

In moments of trauma, the role of the state is to heal—not to judge. A bleeding patient should not be asked to prove innocence before receiving care. The poor, who are most vulnerable to systemic failures—lack of helmets, poor road infrastructure, absence of mental health support—should not be further burdened by financial exclusion.

Universal Health Care is a constitutional right. It is not a reward for good behavior. It must be unconditional, immediate, and rooted in compassion.

In the United Kingdom, the National Health Service treats everyone first. Accountability follows. In the Philippines, we risk doing the opposite—placing judgment before care, and punishment before healing.

Let us not lose sight of the deeper truth:
The measure of a society is how it heals its wounded—not how it punishes them.

We call on the Department of Health to rescind this policy and reaffirm its commitment to the principles of equity, compassion, and justice. Let our hospitals remain places of healing—not sites of discrimination.

🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚦

In order to facilitate proper control and regulation of traffic in connection with Milad-un-Nabi Peace Procession (Birth Anniversary of Prophet Mohammed S.A.W.), the Muslim community will be taking out processions in Hyderabad City on:

📅 Date: 14.09.2025
🕗 Timings: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM
🕌 Main Processions:

1️⃣ From Falaknuma → Volta Hotel via Charminar
2️⃣ From Yahiya Pasha Dargah → Volta Hotel & Return
3️⃣ From Mecca Masjid → Haj House, Nampally
4️⃣ From Mecca Masjid → Volta Hotel
5️⃣ From Pattarghatti → Alijah Kotla

🚧 Traffic Diversions / Stoppages (On need basis)

The traffic will be either stopped or diverted at the following places/routes on need basis on 14-09-2025 from 8 a.m. to 8. p.m.:

1) Falaknuma, 2) Engine Bowli, 3)  Nagulchinta X Road, 4) Himmatpura Junction, 5)Volga, 6) Haribowli, 7) Panch Mohalla, 8) Charminar, 9) Gulzar House, 10) Pattarghatti, 11) Madina Jn., 12) Delhi Gate, 13) Nayapool, 14) SJ Rotary Jn., 15) Darulshifa, 16) Purani Haveli, 17) MIral Mandi, 18) Etebar Chowk, 19) Alijah Kotla, 20) Bibi Bazar, 21) Volta Hotel, 22) Afazalgunj T Junction, 23) Osman Gunj, 24) MJ Market Jn., 25) Taj Island, 26) Nampally T Junction, 27) Haj House,  28) AR Petrol Pump, Nampally.

Citizens are requested to avoid the junctions and routes and take alternative route between 8 AM to 8 PM on 14.09.2025 to reach their destinations to avoid traffic congestion. In case any emergency, the commuters are requested to call our traffic help line 9010203626 for travel assistance and cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.

(D. Joel Davis, IPS.,)
Jt. Commissioner of Police,
Traffic, Hyderabad.
